list.title: Integrations
list.description: External tools your agents can use, connected through MCP (Model Context Protocol).
list.builtinDescription: Ready to use, installed and kept up to date by Abotica.
list.userEmpty: No integrations of your own yet. <link>Add one</link>
list.docsAria: Documentation of {name} (opens in a new tab)

form.name: Name
form.slugInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
form.slugHint: Tools show up for agents as {name}.
form.connectionDescription: Where it runs and how Abotica reaches it.
form.authDescription: How Abotica signs in to the server.
form.authHeadersHint: No auth, or a token in a header
form.authOAuthHint: Sign in through the browser, tokens refresh automatically
form.authSuggest: This server seems to use OAuth.
form.headerCount: {count, plural, =0 {No authentication} one {# header} other {# headers}}
form.testDescription: Connects with the values in the form, even if they are not saved.
form.testDescriptionOAuth: Uses the saved authorization and the values in the form.
form.lastSeen: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} at the last connection
form.assignmentDescription: Agents get its tools directly or through the projects they are on.
form.activeHint: When disabled, agents no longer connect to it.
form.deleteCardDescription: Agents lose its tools. This cannot be undone.
form.deleteDescription: It is removed from every agent and project too.
form.builtinConnectionDescription: Set up by Abotica and updated with it, so it cannot be edited.
form.globalHint: Every agent gets its tools without an assignment. One agent can still turn it off under Tools, Advanced.
form.globalOn: Every agent gets this integration. To keep it from one agent, turn it off in that agent's Tools section, under Advanced.
form.workspaceDescription: Which files the process works with.
form.workspaceServerHint: One process for every agent, with its own files.
form.workspaceRunHint: Reads the files of the agent using it and saves its own next to them, without changing the agent's. Each project gets its own process.
form.advancedSummary: Start within {connect} s, tool calls within {call} s
form.connectTimeoutHint: How long the server may take to start and answer. Empty uses {seconds} s.
form.callTimeoutHint: How long a tool call waits for its answer. Empty uses {seconds} s.

credentialRoutes.title: Credential routes
credentialRoutes.description: The process gets only the route's URL in the variable. Abotica's proxy adds the header with the key to its requests upstream, so the key never enters the sandbox.
credentialRoutes.count: {count, plural, one {# credential route} other {# credential routes}}
credentialRoutes.keyEnvHint: Gets a placeholder value, so clients that require a key still start.

form.sandboxedHint: Isolated from the worker's files. Network access and files are under Advanced.
form.unsandboxedWarning: The process runs directly in the worker, with the worker user's files and network. Only for trusted servers that need host state, such as a browser cache.

oauth.title: Authorization
oauth.disconnectedBody: Agents cannot use this integration until you authorize Abotica. You sign in on the service's page and come back here.
oauth.errorBody: The authorization expired or was revoked. Connect again to restore access.
oauth.afterSave: Saving takes you to the authorization page.
oauth.afterSaveReconnect: Saving drops the current authorization and takes you to the authorization page.
oauth.disconnectDescription: Abotica forgets the tokens and the registered client. Agents lose its tools until you connect again.
oauth.advancedHint: Leave empty and Abotica registers itself automatically (dynamic client registration). Fill in only for servers that require an OAuth app created by hand, with this redirect URI:
oauth.scopeHint: Separated by spaces. Empty: the default scopes of the server.

returned.denied: The authorization was denied on the server.
returned.expired: The authorization took too long or was already used. Press Connect to try again.
returned.failed: The authorization could not be completed.
returned.expiredList: The authorization expired before it was completed. Open the integration and press Connect again.

keyValue.hiddenValueHint: The saved value stays as it is. Values that reference a key are shown; any other value is hidden once saved.

testResult.connected: Connected: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}}

errors.storedValueMissing: The saved value of {key} no longer exists. Type it again.
errors.slugTaken: An integration with the slug "{slug}" already exists
errors.timeout: Timeout: the server did not respond within {seconds}s
errors.fetchFailed: The server cannot be reached (fetch failed). Check the URL and that the server is running.
errors.processClosed: The process closed right after starting. Check the command, arguments and environment variables.
errors.oauthRequired: This server needs authorization. Press Connect (or Reconnect) in the Authentication section.
errors.oauthSaveFirst: Save the server and connect it before testing OAuth.
errors.oauthHttpOnly: OAuth is available only for saved HTTP servers set to OAuth.
errors.builtinDelete: Built-in integrations cannot be deleted. Turn it off instead.
errors.notBuiltin: This is not a built-in integration
errors.noApiKey: This integration does not take an API key
errors.routeEnvName: "{name}" is not a valid variable name: start with a letter and use only letters, digits and underscores.
errors.routeDuplicate: Two credential routes use the variable {name}.
errors.routeUpstream: The upstream of the route {name} must be an https URL without credentials, query or fragment.
errors.routeValueRequired: The route {name} needs a header value.
errors.routeHeader: The header of the route {name} is not valid: use a name the proxy does not set itself (not Host, Connection, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding or Proxy-Authorization) and a value on a single line.

validation.slugFormat: The slug can only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
validation.commandRequired: A command is required for stdio
validation.connectTimeout: The start timeout must be between {min} and {max} seconds
validation.callTimeout: The tool call timeout must be between {min} and {max} seconds

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Optional: a key raises the limits of anonymous use.
apiKey.setHint: Sent with every request. Stored encrypted in Keys as {secret}.
apiKey.anonymousHint: Works without a key, within the free limits.
apiKey.dialogDescription: Stored encrypted in Keys as {secret} and sent as a bearer token. It is not shown again after saving.
apiKey.removed: API key removed: {name} works anonymously again
apiKey.secretDescription: API key of the built-in integration {name}
